Author: mole99
Content:
Currently, the precheck makes no assumptions about the pads, except for checking that the pad masks exists at the right places.

I suppose the platform could provide a test plan for the default padring and the foundry pads, and allow to upload a custom test plan.

However, what format such a test plan should have, and which tests are available (e.g. shorts to other pads, measuring ESD diodes, etc.), would be for @Lauri to say.

Author: anfroholic
Content: This could be something maybe better to have on platform.wafer.space and they can opt in and put data if they care to. If not it will just be the standard.

Author: mithro_
Content: @Leo Moser (mole99) - For now I don't think we want to go the route of providing a test plan or anything. I was thinking that the precheck should enable checking what ever needs to be checked so that it means @Lauri's tester will work with his default testing setup.
